title: SWF: Sprite nesting depth and character ID management
description: Unit tests for correct character ID assignment when SWF has nested sprites. Two symbols placed on stage should get distinct character IDs. A symbol defined inside another should also have a unique ID. Verify no ID collisions across all DefineSprite, DefineShape, DefineBitsLossless2 tags. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/charids.test.ts.
